Analyse the training examples:
- The input consists of 2x2 blocks of a single color (e.g. 2, 6, etc.) aligned on a grid.
- Looking at the output, lines of color 5 (gray) connect certain blocks horizontally or vertically.
- Notice:
  - In Example 1:
    - Vertical columns with blocks: col 5-6 and col 17-18. All blocks in col 5-6 are connected vertically by 5s. All blocks in col 17-18 are connected vertically by 5s.
    - Horizontal rows: row 14-15 has blocks at (14, 5), (14, 13), (14, 17). They are connected horizontally by 5s!
    - Wait, why are other blocks not connected horizontally?
    - Let's check row 1-2: blocks at (1, 5) and (1, 17). Are they connected horizontally? No!
    - Wait, why row 14-15? There is an extra block at (14, 13)!
    - Let's check Example 2:
      - Blocks of 6:
        - Row 1-2: cols 12-13, 17-18, 25-26. They are connected horizontally!
        - Row 7-8: col 25-26 only.
        - Row 10-11: cols 12-13, 17-18, 25-26. They are connected horizontally!
        - Row 13-14: col 25-26 only.
        - In the vertical direction: only col 25-26 is connected vertically! Col 12-13 has blocks at rows 1-2 and rows 10-11, but they are NOT connected vertically!
    - Let's check Example 3:
      - Blocks of 2:
        - Rows with blocks:
          - Row 0-1: col 5-6, col 19-20. (NOT connected horizontally)
          - Row 3-4: col 5-6, col 8-9, col 19-20. (CONNECTED horizontally!)
          - Row 7-8: col 5-6, col 19-20. (NOT connected horizontally)
          - Row 12-13: col 5-6, col 19-20. (NOT connected horizontally)
        - Columns:
          - Col 5-6: rows 0-1, 3-4, 7-8, 12-13. (CONNECTED vertically!)
          - Col 8-9: row 3-4 only.
          - Col 19-20: rows 0-1, 3-4, 7-8, 12-13. (CONNECTED vertically!)
  - What is the rule?
    - In Example 1:
      - Col 5-6 has 4 blocks.
      - Col 17-18 has 4 blocks.
      - Col 13-14 has 1 block.
      - Row 1-2 has 2 blocks.
      - Row 7-8 has 2 blocks.
      - Row 11-12 has 2 blocks.
      - Row 14-15 has 3 blocks.
      - Connected: col 5-6 (4 blocks), col 17-18 (4 blocks), row 14-15 (3 blocks).
      - Not connected: row 1-2 (2), row 7-8 (2), row 11-12 (2), col 13-14 (1).
    - In Example 2:
      - Row 1-2 has 3 blocks.
      - Row 10-11 has 3 blocks.
      - Row 7-8 has 1 block.
      - Row 13-14 has 1 block.
      - Col 12-13 has 2 blocks.
      - Col 17-18 has 2 blocks.
      - Col 25-26 has 4 blocks.
      - Connected: row 1-2 (3 blocks), row 10-11 (3 blocks), col 25-26 (4 blocks).
      - Not connected: col 12-13 (2 blocks), col 17-18 (2 blocks).
    - In Example 3:
      - Col 5-6 has 4 blocks.
      - Col 19-20 has 4 blocks.
      - Row 3-4 has 3 blocks.
      - Connected: Col 5-6 (4), Col 19-20 (4), Row 3-4 (3).
      - Not connected: rows with 2 blocks, col with 1 block!

Rule:
Lines (horizontal pairs of rows or vertical pairs of columns containing 2x2 blocks) that have **3 or more** blocks are connected by color 5 (between the first and last block along that line)!
Wait, check: is it >= 3 blocks?
Example 1:
- rows with blocks:
  - row 1-2: 2 blocks -> not connected
  - row 7-8: 2 blocks -> not connected
  - row 11-12: 2 blocks -> not connected
  - row 14-15: 3 blocks -> connected!
- cols with blocks:
  - col 5-6: 4 blocks -> connected!
  - col 13-14: 1 block -> not connected
  - col 17-18: 4 blocks -> connected!

Example 2:
- rows with blocks:
  - row 1-2: 3 blocks -> connected!
  - row 7-8: 1 block -> not
  - row 10-11: 3 blocks -> connected!
  - row 13-14: 1 block -> not
- cols with blocks:
  - col 12-13: 2 blocks -> not connected!
  - col 17-18: 2 blocks -> not connected!
  - col 25-26: 4 blocks -> connected!

Example 3:
- rows:
  - row 0-1: 2 -> not
  - row 3-4: 3 -> connected!
  - row 7-8: 2 -> not
  - row 12-13: 2 -> not
- cols:
  - col 5-6: 4 -> connected!
  - col 8-9: 1 -> not
  - col 19-20: 4 -> connected!

Yes! Exactly: Any row-pair or col-pair of 2x2 blocks that contains 3 or more blocks has all empty spaces between the blocks filled with 5!

Let's await the test input.I have identified the transformation rule:
The input contains 2×2 blocks of a uniform color.
For any pair of rows or columns containing **3 or more** 2×2 blocks, the segments connecting these blocks along that row/column (from the first block to the last block) are filled with color 5 (gray).

Please provide the test input.
